assets.name: flame
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one reusable low-resolution Roblox particle / VFX sprite.
Style: VERY SIMPLE low-poly inspired flat 2D silhouette, chunky straight edges and angular geometric facets. Large readable shapes. Maximum 2-3 broad opacity regions. No fine detail, no noisy texture, no realism.
Color: pure white only, varying ALPHA transparency for engine tinting. No gray shading painted as color.
Output request: small 256x256 PNG (512x512 only for rings), transparent alpha background.
Composition: one centered symbol/effect, fully inside canvas with at least 15% empty transparent margin. No atlas, no multiple variants.
Avoid: text, borders, watermark, painted checkerboard, black backdrop, scenery, perspective, detailed clouds, micro-particles, overdone blur/glow.
Subject: A single chunky flame with three pointed tongues made from 6-8 straight polygon edges. Wide base, tall middle tip and short sides. Solid white central tongue and just one translucent angular outer shape; a very small soft edge fade. Upright.
